summary: Docebo Inc. filed a 6-K reporting preliminary results of a substantial issuer bid (the Canadian equivalent of an issuer tender offer) to repurchase up to US$70,000,000 of common shares at US$25.00 per share. The offer expired September 8, 2026; only 99,332 shares were tendered, for total consideration of US$2,483,300, about 0.4% of shares outstanding. Intercap Inc., holding roughly 63.9%, tendered only 13,351 shares, leaving it at about 63.7% post-offer. Funding is entirely from cash on hand, with no incremental credit facility borrowings. Watch for final verification, guaranteed-delivery settlement, and the low take-up signaling limited shareholder interest near the C$32.44 specified amount.
